evals.prompt: Turn an existing four-hour session prep with a strong start, two routes, three encounter owners, a visible faction clock, and an off-map fallback into a DM-only run guide. Do not invent canon or write player-facing narration.
evals.expected_output: A table-ready guide opens with a 30-second strong start, state/stakes strip, explicit clock strip, quick key index, PC limelight links, and a parachute. Each live card has a stable key, trigger/state, pressure, stakes, options/off-ramp, run procedure, and next state; encounter details remain linked or compressed into table cards.
expectations: Provides a dashboard with strong start, state/stakes, clock fields, quick index, roster/limelight, and parachute trigger.
Uses stable card keys and world-state triggers rather than a mandatory scene sequence or player-read prose.
Keeps encounter cards actionable with objective, opposition move, terrain, public stakes, off-ramp, and aftermath.
Includes the concrete silence loop and does not fill silence with an invented beat or NPC monologue.
